verdict.rationale: A mobile on-call app is a fair question for an alerting and incident management platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions a FireHydrant mobile app or acknowledging, escalating, or resolving alerts from a phone. 'Multi-platform notifications' and alert-acknowledgement analytics are adjacent features and do not show a mobile app.

support.subject: As an on-call engineer, a full mobile app lets me acknowledge, escalate, and resolve from my phone at 3am
